970043: It is natural for most nail polishes to thicken over time due to the evaporation of solvents when exposed to air and Lacquer Reviver is the answer to it! Lacquer Reviver is a nail polish thinner which reintroduces the evaporated solvents into your nail polish to help restore the original consistency of the polish. To effectively use Lacquer Reviver, add a few drops of the nail polish thinner to the polish. Start with a small amount such as 4-5 drops and add more as needed. Then, ensure that the nail polish bottle is tightly closed and shake it thoroughly to mix the thinner with the nail polish. Lacquer Reviver comes in a 50ml bottle with a dropper lid. Please make sure that the cap is fully screwed closed when putting it away. Please note: Lacquer Reviver is not compatible with water-based nail polish formulas. When in doubt, have a quick look at the ingredients of the nail polish you want to thin to ensure that Ethyl Acetate and Butyl Acetate are the main solvents in it. Ingredients: Butyl Acetate, Ethyl Acetate.
